parsed.post: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 significantly improved val_bpb from 0.892 to 0.864. The model is scaling well within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll attempt to optimize the learning rate and aspect ratio to see if we can squeeze out more performance with this larger architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and testing a lower MATRIX_LR with a higher ASPECT_RATIO to improve capacity and stability.
